tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light, warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: post cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: diff headers, inset wells, code blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: handles, timestamps, captions, source publishers.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary accent FILL: buttons, nav selection, selection highlight, wordmark dot. Burnt caramel in light, bright gold in dark.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon color that sits ON an accent fill. White on caramel, near-black on gold. NEVER the reverse.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent color for SMALL TEXT on a page/card surface (eyebrows, chips, ref IDs, links). Deeper than accent in light mode so small gold text stays legible on white; same as accent in dark.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Low-saturation accent wash: chip backgrounds, selected-row fills, hover states.

tokens.name: signal-add
tokens.usage: Additions in diffs/revisions. RESERVED semantic green — never used as accent.

tokens.name: signal-del
tokens.usage: Removals in diffs/revisions. RESERVED semantic red — never used as accent.

tokens.name: signal-add-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill behind an addition line.

tokens.name: signal-del-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill behind a removal line.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Did the city cut library hours?

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text: post body, article content. The reading tier.
styles.sample: The claim traveled faster than the correction.

styles.name: pullquote
styles.sample: The reduction was closer to twelve percent.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and status pills. Use with text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Diff lines, raw source, reference IDs.

styles.name: mono-num
styles.usage: Tabular counts and metrics. Pair with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: icon-to-label, chip internals.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Small gap: between chips, inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, standard block spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section separation within a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Major section breaks on a page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, frames.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Post cards, dialogs, large containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for post cards and panels.
